description: This file defines a class 'Conditional' in the PhpSpreadsheet library, containing static methods implementing logical functions similar to Excel formulas such as IF, SWITCH, IFERROR, IFNA, and IFS. It provides logical evaluation utilities used for spreadsheet calculations.

classes.name: Conditional
classes.description: A class providing static methods for logical operations similar to Excel functions, including IF, SWITCH, IFERROR, IFNA, and IFS.

methods.name: statementIf
methods.description: Evaluates a condition and returns one of two values based on the condition's boolean evaluation, similar to the IF function.

methods.name: statementSwitch
methods.description: Imitates the SWITCH function, returning a result based on matching a target value against a list of possibilities, with optional default.

methods.name: IFERROR
methods.description: Returns a specified value if the test value is an error; otherwise, returns the test value.

methods.name: IFNA
methods.description: Returns a specified value if the test value is #N/A error; otherwise, returns the test value.

methods.name: IFS
methods.description: Implements the IFS function, evaluating multiple test conditions sequentially and returning corresponding results.

search-terms: IF, SWITCH, IFERROR, IFNA, IFS functions
